launches.title: Magma - AI labs will pay you to learn from your agent's mistakes
launches.tagline: We enable any company monetize its agents' traces!
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Magma enables companies building AI agents to monetize their data in a few clicks.

<https://youtu.be/NIqRZSu82JM>

**❌ The problem**

If a product uses AI agents, every interaction creates valuable data. That could be a user correcting an agent’s mistake, or an agent discovering a new way to complete a workflow. That real-world data currently sits unused, while the best alternative is human annotators inventing hypothetical scenarios.

**✅ What we do**

Magma turns that data into recurring revenue for companies.

Companies share their agents’ traces in a few clicks. Access is read-only and encrypted, and nothing is shared without approval. Magma anonymizes the data, turns it into complex training environments, and handles licensing to AI labs. Every time the data is licensed, the company gets paid.

**👋 Who I am**

I’ve previously built the first Persian OCR model and legal LLM for my startup in Iran, formulated new transformer-based ML architectures in Oxford, and created a dev tool context management for agents that worked so well I decided to repurpose it to extract training data from traces (now Magma).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110488&key=user_uploads/3107607/07bc99c4-63f2-4235-870e-9b97977f8c43)

**🧐 But why?**

We believe no two AI agents on the planet should be corrected for the same mistake. This is why we're building infrastructure to turn the experience of any AI agent into generalizable learning signals to improve any other AI agent.

**🫡 Our ask**

Do you know anyone at a frontier lab looking for RL environments built from real production workflows, or at an enterprise in need of fine-tuning their models on niche tasks? Let us know and we can help: [ramtin@magmahq.ai](mailto:ramtin@magmahq.ai)

Also, you can start monetizing your agents’ traces at: [magmahq.ai](http://magmahq.ai)
